metadata.title: DriftLab Agent Behavioral Controls
metadata.remarks: Behavioral control family for running agentic systems. Prop namespace: https://sw30labs.com/ns/dl. Each DL control links to its SP 800-53r5 anchors; CA-7 (continuous monitoring) is the family's umbrella control — DriftLab is its implementation for agent behavior.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The agent invokes only tools on the certified per-node allowlist. Any tool call outside the allowlist is a decision-rights violation.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: For every certified decision node, the agent routes only to certified target nodes. Observed transitions outside the certified route set are routing violations.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: When a certified trigger condition matches a decision context, the run escalates to the certified human gate before committing output. Bypassing the gate is a HITL violation.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: After an error at a certified node, the run's next step is the certified fallback path. Continuing normal flow past an error is a fallback violation.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Nodes designated critical sinks (funds movement, external commitments, irreversible actions) escalate the severity of any drift on a path that reaches them.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The fraction of routing decisions taking the full-autonomy path stays within the certified budget over the observation window.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Every run executes the certified required steps, and runtime decision traces are captured continuously as compliance evidence.
